snippet.title: Patch me... if you can!
snippet.description:
"Patch Me If You Can" is a puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world, freely manipulating objects. Equip blocks to shrink rocks, move the sun, and thwart a lord’s conspiracy. This broken world needs your "patch"!

"Patch Me If You Can" will be released for free on Steam on July 25, 2025! Add it to your Steam wishlist now! 👀👍
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3827840/Patch_me_if_you_can/
